requests.purpose: Discover actual BMS resource DB shape and existing read/write SQLite front end; no database changes
requests.shell: cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; command -v sqlite3; command -v rdb; ls -lnZ /data/service/el1/public/bms/bundle_resources/; ls -lnZ /system/bin/sqlite3 /system/bin/rdb; printf '\nREMOTE_RC=%s\n' "$?"

requests.purpose: Receive existing DB and any present -wal/-shm with SHA bookends to fresh local evidence; receive only paths proven present by CACHE-TOOLS-AND-PATHS
requests.note: Source hashes before and after all receives must agree. Open only a separate disposable local copy including WAL; original received files stay unchanged. No whole live DB replacement.
